items.title: Docker Networking Under the Hood
items.description: Complete guide to Docker networking — veth pairs, docker0 bridge mechanics, iptables SNAT/DNAT port forwarding, user-defined bridge DNS resolution, and network drivers.

items.title: Proxies, Firewalls, NAT & VPNs
